love.upright: In love, the Five of Pentacles suggests loneliness, a lack of care, or a relationship going through a hard time. State your needs, do not isolate yourself and seek comfort from family or friends you can trust.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests a relationship recovering or you finding a trustworthy companion after a hard time. Treasure that presence and allow yourself to trust again bit by bit.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests a hard phase such as losing a job, falling income or feeling left behind. Look for a support network, learn new skills and do not hesitate to ask for referrals. The door may be closer than you think.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows job opportunities returning or you being supported to get back up. Seize the opportunity, persevere and strengthen your foundation so you do not fall back into the old situation.

study.upright: In study, you may face financial difficulty or feel abandoned. Look for sources of support such as scholarships, teachers or friends; do not hesitate to ask.
study.reversed: Reversed, difficulties are easing and help is arriving. Keep persisting and accept support when needed.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests scarcity or worry about money. List your expenses, cut non-essentials, look for legitimate sources of support and seek professional advice. Facing concrete numbers is usually lighter than vague worry.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it suggests your finances gradually stabilizing. Keep up discipline, build a small emergency fund and remember the lessons of the hard time so you can live more steadily.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card reminds you not to ignore tiredness, isolation or prolonged anxiety. Seek support from loved ones or health services and care for your body with basics like eating and sleeping enough. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests you are gradually recovering physically and mentally. Keep up your care habits, accept support and increase activity step by step so you do not overdo it.

pentacles-5.symbolism: Two wanderers walk in snow before a stained-glass window of a warm lit church, on which five coins are arranged in the shape of the Tree of Life. The lame one on crutches suggests physical hurt, and the one ahead wrapped tightly in a shawl shows curling up in worry. They do not look at the window, showing that help is close by yet missed. The falling snow and dark sky suggest the harshness of circumstances. The lit window is hope and shelter. The card belongs to the element of Earth, number 5 is a trial, and it is linked to Mercury in Taurus.
pentacles-5.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: hardship.

pentacles-6.name: Six of Pentacles
pentacles-6.meaning_upright: The Six of Pentacles is the image of a wealthy merchant weighing money, one hand dropping coins to a kneeling beggar and the other holding the scales. The card speaks of the flow of giving and receiving, of generosity and fairness. You may be helping others with money, time or knowledge, or receiving support when you need it. Both roles have value, and they are not always fixed. Give out of kindness, so the recipient does not feel lesser, and receive with gratitude, not shame. When you look at the balance between giving and receiving in your life, your relationships become healthier too.
pentacles-6.meaning_reversed: When the Six of Pentacles is reversed, the flow of giving and taking may be skewed. There may be hidden strings, debts, dependence, or someone giving in order to control. You may also be giving too much without being appreciated, or receiving without returning. The card asks you to check for fairness and set boundaries. State your expectations clearly, do not give out of pressure or guilt, and do not accept when the hidden price is too high. Real generosity does not demand repayment.

love.upright: In love, the Six of Pentacles suggests balanced giving and receiving, care shown through action and a readiness to support when the other person needs it. Be generous with time and attention, and learn to let the other person take care of you.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests one side giving too much, or hidden conditions in the relationship. Speak plainly about fairness, redistribute responsibilities and do not use kindness as a tool of control.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests mutual support, mentorship, bonuses or opportunities to share resources. Guide new colleagues, accept help when needed and build a fair work culture.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows unfairness in dividing work or rewards, or help that comes with conditions. Clarify the agreement, keep it in writing and confidently ask for fairness.

study.upright: In study, you may receive or give support such as a scholarship, tutoring or shared materials. Exchange fairly and with gratitude.
study.reversed: Reversed, support may be uneven or come with conditions. Be clear about the arrangement and do not become too dependent.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests donating, sharing, lending or receiving support. Give and take within your means, write down the arrangement and let generosity come with caution. Balancing income and spending is also a kind of fairness to yourself.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of debt, unclear lending or financial dependence. Make the terms transparent, set clear limits and avoid lending or borrowing before you understand the responsibility.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card suggests support from community, loved ones or care services. Allow yourself to accept help and accompany others when you can. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests a lack of support or giving so much that your energy is drained. Set limits, ask others to share responsibility and put your own care first.

pentacles-6.symbolism: A merchant in a luxurious red-purple cloak stands between two kneeling figures in ragged clothes, his right hand holding the scales as a symbol of fairness and his left dropping a coin. Six coins in the sky are arranged in two groups, showing the division. The scales remind us that generosity needs to come with consideration. The two kneeling figures may be recipients or simply people in different positions, but both look up toward the giver. The deep black background sets off the scene. The card belongs to the element of Earth, is tied to the number 6, harmony, and is linked to the Moon in Taurus.
pentacles-6.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: sharing.

pentacles-7.name: Seven of Pentacles
pentacles-7.meaning_upright: The Seven of Pentacles is the image of a farmer leaning on his hoe, gazing at a bush bearing seven coins. The card speaks of a stage where you have sown, tended and are now waiting for results. You may be investing time, effort or money in a long-term project, and this is the moment to stop and assess. See what is growing well, what needs adjusting and do not let impatience spoil the process. A plant cannot grow faster than its natural pace, but steady care will be repaid. Be patient, be proud of what you have done and continue calmly.
pentacles-7.meaning_reversed: When the Seven of Pentacles is reversed, you may be impatient at not yet seeing results, or realize you are investing in the wrong place. You may have put in a lot of effort without matching reward, or worked without a plan. The card asks you to evaluate your strategy frankly: what is working and what should stop. Do not quit too early just because things are slow, but do not cling stubbornly to a path with no future either. A skillful adjustment is always better than blind perseverance.

love.upright: In love, the Seven of Pentacles suggests patience in nurturing a relationship, investing time in each other and waiting for closeness to grow. Care for it steadily through small actions and check whether you are both investing.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests impatience or a feeling that your effort is not returned in the relationship. Talk about expectations, review your shared pace and do not force progress faster than it can go.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests a phase of assessing a long-term project where you wait patiently for results. Track progress, adjust your plan and stay diligent. The results are growing even if not yet visible.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows you are discouraged by slow results or realizing your direction is not effective. Review your goals, ask for feedback and be ready to change your approach if needed.

study.upright: In study, you have put in plenty of effort and now need to assess your progress. Be patient, do not compare yourself with others and keep tending to it steadily.
study.reversed: Reversed, you are impatient, not seeing results or investing in the wrong direction. Review your method and adjust with purpose.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests long-term investing, steady saving and waiting for compounding returns. Check your portfolio periodically, keep discipline and avoid selling off or switching constantly out of impatience.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of investing without a plan, expecting fast profit or wasting resources. Re-evaluate effectiveness, seek professional advice and do not put more money where there is no foundation.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages building sustainable habits such as regular exercise and eating, and tracking progress. Results come slowly but surely. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests impatience at slow progress or habits that are not effective. Set realistic goals, track with small measures and adjust your plan instead of giving up.

pentacles-7.symbolism: A farmer stands leaning on his hoe, slightly bent, looking intently at a green bush hung with seven coins, with a contemplative expression. One coin lies on the ground, suggesting what has been harvested or needs assessing. The bush grows from soft soil, showing life developing. His green and yellow clothes and the pale sky suggest calm. The posture of rest while his eyes are fixed on the results shows effort paired with waiting. The card belongs to the element of Earth, is tied to the number 7, the test of patience, and is linked to Saturn in Taurus.
pentacles-7.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: patience.

pentacles-8.name: Eight of Pentacles
pentacles-8.meaning_upright: The Eight of Pentacles is the image of a craftsman sitting at a bench, patiently carving each coin, the finished ones neatly displayed. The card speaks of diligence, honing your craft and devotion to quality. You may be learning a new skill, perfecting your work or accepting repetition in order to get better. Focus on each detail, enjoy the growing mastery and trust that effort will respond. There are no shortcuts to mastery. When you work with dedication, the work gives not just results but satisfaction from the process itself.
pentacles-8.meaning_reversed: When the Eight of Pentacles is reversed, you may be working carelessly, unfocused, or perfectionistic to the point of exhaustion. You may also find the work boring and meaningless, or be pursuing a goal that does not suit you. The card asks you to find your original reason again, set reasonable standards and rest. Tell diligence apart from self-punishment. Learning with joy lasts longer than learning by force.

love.upright: In love, the Eight of Pentacles suggests effort to build the relationship through steady action, attention to detail and learning to love better. Make quality time, be patient and show affection through concrete deeds.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests you are so busy with work that you neglect the relationship, or you are going through the motions. Rearrange your time, pay attention to the person beside you and talk about both of your needs.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests learning a trade, raising skills, working in depth and being recognized for quality. Set learning goals, practise steadily and make use of your meticulousness.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows a loss of motivation, repetitive work that is not effective, or perfectionism causing delay. Set deadlines, accept 'good enough' on unimportant parts and find ways to refresh your work.

study.upright: In study, diligence, care and practice of skills are what is needed. Practise regularly, attend to details and master your craft step by step.
study.reversed: Reversed, you may be going through the motions, being too perfectionistic or bored with repetitive work. Find your purpose again and study with a strategy.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests income rising thanks to skill and effort. Invest in training, keep a regular saving habit and build your reputation through quality work.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of work that does not bring matching income or spending on courses that are not effective. Re-evaluate the benefit, choose suitable programs and focus on what creates real value.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages regular training, building sustainable habits and attention to correct technique. Small daily progress makes a big difference. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests exhaustion from overtraining or boring habits. Rest, change your exercises and remind yourself that rest is part of progress.

pentacles-8.symbolism: A young craftsman in an apron sits on a stone bench, using a hammer and chisel on the eighth coin, six finished coins hung on a post and one set at his feet. The small village in the distance shows he is working focused and set apart from the noise. His bent posture stresses concentration. The repeated arrangement of the coins suggests practice. The card belongs to the element of Earth, is tied to the number 8, and is linked to the Sun in Virgo, the place of meticulousness and service.
pentacles-8.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: diligence.

pentacles-9.name: Nine of Pentacles
pentacles-9.meaning_upright: The Nine of Pentacles is the image of a woman at ease in a vineyard heavy with grapes, a falcon perched on her hand, her face calm. The card speaks of independence and prosperity achieved through your own effort. You may be enjoying your results, feeling self-sufficient and having a stable base. Allow yourself to rest and enjoy the good things you have cultivated, from the garden and home to the sense of security. This independence does not mean isolation but the ability to stand on your own feet and to choose companions out of liking, not need. Be grateful for the journey so far and keep living gracefully in your own way.
pentacles-9.meaning_reversed: When the Nine of Pentacles is reversed, your sense of independence may waver: you may be worried about finances, dependent on others or showing off to cover insecurity. You may also be so focused on material things that you are lonely, or spending to create an appearance of success. The card asks you to build real self-reliance through plans and skills while also nurturing your inner life. Your worth lies not in what you own but in how you live.

love.upright: In love, the Nine of Pentacles suggests confidence, independence and loving from a place of fullness. You do not need anyone to fill an emptiness, but are glad to share this good life with the right person. Value yourself and choose relationships that lift each other up.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests you lean on others to feel safe, or feel lonely though things look fine. Rebuild your confidence, tend to your emotional needs and avoid using material things in place of connection.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests success, financial independence and work that gives you autonomy. Enjoy the results, keep raising your skills and keep a balance between work and life.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows a lack of autonomy at work or worry about stability. Build a base of skills, diversify income and avoid showing off beyond your means.

study.upright: In study, you achieve results through independent effort and can be self-directed. Enjoy the fruits and keep learning to better yourself.
study.reversed: Reversed, you depend too much on achievement or do not know how to enjoy it. Remember your worth is not only in grades.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests abundance, security and the ability to spend consciously. Keep your saving habits, enjoy the results in moderation and keep investing for the future.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of showy spending or financial insecurity though things look stable. Review your budget, avoid debt taken on to keep up an image and seek advice when needed.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages relaxation, self-care and enjoying quiet space. Keep healthy habits and spend time in nature. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests loneliness or insecurity affecting your mood. Connect with loved ones, look after your feelings and do not measure your worth by achievement alone.

pentacles-9.symbolism: A woman in a yellow gown embroidered with patterns stands in a vineyard full of fruit, a leather-gloved left hand holding a perched falcon and the right hand resting lightly on a bunch of grapes. The hooded falcon suggests control of instinct and discipline. The small snail at her feet stands for patience. Nine coins along the vine are accumulated results. The distant castle shows security and status. The warm yellow background creates a feeling of peace. The card belongs to the element of Earth, is tied to the number 9, and is linked to Venus in Virgo, the place of refinement and conscious enjoyment.
pentacles-9.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: self-reliance.

pentacles-10.name: Ten of Pentacles
pentacles-10.meaning_upright: The Ten of Pentacles is the image of a multigenerational family living in prosperity beneath the archway of a city. The card speaks of lasting stability, legacy and the joy of good things being passed down. You may be building a foundation for many years to come, such as a home, a lasting career or a financial fund. This is the result of many small steps adding up. Value tradition, nurture family bonds and share your results with the people you love. True wealth is not only assets but the feeling of safety, belonging and handing down something meaningful to the next generation.
pentacles-10.meaning_reversed: When the Ten of Pentacles is reversed, the foundation may be shaky: there may be family conflict, a dispute over assets or a long-term plan that is not yet firm. You may also be too focused on material things at the expense of bonds, or feel tied down by family expectations. The card asks you to talk openly, be transparent about money and look again at what is truly worth handing down. Strengthen your foundation step by step and do not trade relationships for assets.

love.upright: In love, the Ten of Pentacles suggests long-term commitment, building a family or a stable shared life. Set long-term goals together, respect family values and nurture a shared sense of security.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests disagreement about family values, pressure from expectations or a lack of common ground. Talk frankly about the future, money and each person's role to avoid misunderstandings piling up.

career.upright: In your career, the card suggests a stable career, a family business or an organization with a solid foundation. Build long-term credibility, manage resources carefully and think about the professional legacy you want to leave.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows instability in an organization, conflicts of interest or an unclear succession plan. Make roles transparent, strengthen processes and discuss with the people involved.

study.upright: In study, a solid educational foundation and the support of family or tradition. Invest for the long term and build a lasting career.
study.reversed: Reversed, family pressure or expectations about results may weigh on you. Talk it over and choose the path that suits you.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests prosperity, assets and long-term management. Make plans for saving, insurance and appropriate inheritance, and stay transparent with your family. Strategic decisions bring lasting peace of mind.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of property disputes, shared debt or a financial foundation that is not firm. Read documents carefully, consult a legal or financial professional and talk openly with the people involved.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card suggests the reassurance of being supported by family and community. Keep healthy shared routines. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests stress from family pressure or financial worry affecting your mood. Share with loved ones, set healthy boundaries and seek support when needed.

pentacles-10.symbolism: An old man sits beneath a city archway, his robe embroidered with grapes, two dogs gathered around him, with a couple and a child behind, showing three generations. Ten coins hang in the air arranged in the shape of the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, expressing the wholeness of matter and spirit. The gate and castle suggest safety and lineage. The dogs are loyalty. Warm sunlight falls over the scene. The card belongs to the element of Earth, is tied to the number 10, the completion of a cycle, and is linked to Mercury in Virgo.
pentacles-10.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: legacy.

pentacles-page.name: Page of Pentacles
pentacles-page.meaning_upright: The Page of Pentacles is a young person standing in a field, holding up a coin and gazing at it with fascination. The card suggests the start of a practical goal, a chance to learn or a project that can grow over time. You may be entering a stage of learning a trade, making a financial plan, building a health habit or pursuing a new skill. Approach it with curiosity and patience: break goals into small steps, keep practicing and watch your progress. Do not be afraid to start from the position of a beginner, since all expertise grows up from there. When you lay each brick carefully, the foundation will be solid.
pentacles-page.meaning_reversed: When the Page of Pentacles is reversed, you may lack focus, procrastinate, or daydream about success without starting to work. You may also lack commitment, quit halfway or expect results too fast. The card reminds you to set specific goals, break the work down and persist with a daily habit. Choose one thing, do it well and then expand. A lack of realism can be fixed with a clear plan.

love.upright: In love, the Page of Pentacles suggests gentle seriousness, a slow start and a wish to build a solid foundation. Get to know each other well, show care through concrete actions and let the relationship grow at its natural pace.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests a lack of commitment, vagueness about direction or not giving the relationship enough time. State your expectations, set aside time for each other and do not hover forever among promises.

career.upright: In your career, the card signals an opportunity to learn a trade, an internship or a small project that can grow. Work diligently, ask those ahead of you and turn knowledge into practice. A firm foundation is built from details.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows a lack of drive, procrastination or expecting too much too fast. Set weekly goals, track progress and find a mentor to help you keep pace.

study.upright: In study, you are eager to learn practical things and may have a scholarship or new course opportunity. Make a concrete plan and start with small steps.
study.reversed: Reversed, you lack focus or put things off. Set clear goals and track progress instead of daydreaming.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests beginning to save, learning to manage money or investing a little with a plan. Note down your spending, set concrete goals and increase gradually once you are used to it. Financial knowledge is a good investment.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of a lack of planning, careless spending or illusions of getting rich quickly. Start with a simple budget, avoid borrowing when unclear and learn from trustworthy sources.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages starting new habits such as walking, balanced eating and sleeping on time. Be consistent and track your progress. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests irregular habits or dropping them halfway. Choose an activity you really like, set smaller goals and find a companion to keep it up.

pentacles-page.symbolism: A young person stands in the middle of a plowed field, wearing a red outer garment over a green one and a hat with a plume, holding a coin up at eye level in both hands. The intent gaze suggests thoughtful, absorbed study. The field represents earth ready for sowing, and the green trees and distant mountains behind are long-term goals. The clear sky and golden background show a practical beginning. The card belongs to the element of Earth within the suit of Pentacles, representing material learning with patience.
pentacles-page.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: learning.

pentacles-knight.name: Knight of Pentacles
pentacles-knight.meaning_upright: The Knight of Pentacles is a knight on a black horse standing still in a plowed field, carefully holding a coin. He is the image of reliability, persistence and devotion. Unlike the other knights who charge forward, he advances slowly and surely, checking each step. You may be pursuing a long-term goal with discipline, fulfilling responsibilities or needing to keep a steady pace instead of sprinting. The card encourages you to work consistently, keep your word and build credibility through consistency. This success is not noisy but lasting, and other people's trust will grow over time.
pentacles-knight.meaning_reversed: When the Knight of Pentacles is reversed, persistence can turn into stagnation, rigidity or boredom. You may cling to old habits for fear of change, work so perfectionistically that you do not move forward, or on the contrary be lazy and avoid responsibility. The card asks you to look at what is leaving you stuck, to try a little flexibility and to set realistic deadlines. Remember that slow and steady still needs a direction and a rhythm.

love.upright: In love, the Knight of Pentacles suggests a loyal, reliable partner who shows affection through deeds. Build the relationship steadily, keep your promises and value stability.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests boredom, a lack of surprise or rigidity in the relationship. Refresh your shared routines, share your feelings more clearly and do not let stability turn into silence.

career.upright: In your career, the card encourages hard, dependable work and steadiness toward long-term goals. Make detailed plans, finish one task at a time and build your reputation on consistent quality.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows stagnant work, excessive perfectionism or fear of change. Try a new method, set a deadline and accept small risks in order to move forward.

study.upright: In study, you are persistent, dependable and work steadily. Though slow, this enduring way of studying will bring you to solid results.
study.reversed: Reversed, you may be too slow, bored or stuck in habit. Add some flexibility and find new motivation.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests careful management, slow but steady investing and regular saving. Track spending, put safety first and avoid hasty decisions. Persistence is money's best companion.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of being so conservative that you miss opportunities or avoid a financial plan. Consider new advice, diversify sensibly and do not let fear of risk keep you standing still.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages regular habits, balanced eating and sustained movement. Stick to your long-term plan instead of looking for quick fixes. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests inflexibility in habits or discouragement from slow progress. Change your exercises, try something new and remember that rest matters just as much.

pentacles-knight.symbolism: The knight in armor, wearing a hat with oak leaves, sits on a big, strong black horse standing still in a freshly plowed field. The steady black horse stands for the power of earth and constancy. He looks intently at the coin in his hand, as if considering carefully. The field laid out in neat furrows suggests diligence and planning. The gray-gold sky above stresses calm. The card belongs to the element of Fire within the suit of Pentacles, combining action with matter and creating enduring determination.
pentacles-knight.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: endurance.

pentacles-queen.name: Queen of Pentacles
pentacles-queen.meaning_upright: The Queen of Pentacles is a woman seated in a flourishing garden, cradling a coin like a treasured thing. The card stands for practical care, generosity and the ability to create a warm, well-provided space. You may be nurturing a family, a project, a garden or your own body. Combine practicality with affection, manage resources skillfully and let those around you feel safe. The card encourages you to enjoy the simple things like a good meal, a tidy home and green plants. True wealth is when you can share warmth without draining yourself.
pentacles-queen.meaning_reversed: When the Queen of Pentacles is reversed, care can become worry, suffocation, or neglecting yourself while looking after others. You may also be obsessed with material things, envious of others' results or dependent on possessions to feel safe. The card reminds you to balance giving and receiving, set boundaries and make sure your own needs are met too. Care in a way that does not control, and do not let worry hide your joy.

love.upright: In love, the Queen of Pentacles suggests warm care, concrete attention and creating a living space full of affection. Show love through small things like cooking and tending the home, while allowing your partner to take care of you.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests suffocation from too much care, or material jealousy. Set boundaries, say what you need and avoid using sacrifice as a way to hold someone.

career.upright: In your career, the card encourages balancing work and family, building a warm work environment and managing resources realistically. Work involving care, food, agriculture or personal finance may suit you.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows you are overloaded from taking on too much responsibility or neglecting work because of worrying about home. Share tasks, make a clear schedule and recognize that you do not have to do everything alone.

study.upright: In study, you are thoughtful, practical and able to make a comfortable learning environment. Take care of yourself, arrange your study corner and study with a method.
study.reversed: Reversed, you may be worrying too much or neglecting yourself. Balance responsibilities with study.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests wise spending management, putting your family's safety first and enjoying results in moderation. Make a realistic budget, save steadily and set aside a little for small joys.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of excessive worry about money, spending to console your feelings or comparing yourself with others. Look at the real numbers, tell needs from wants and set financial goals according to your own values.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages caring for your body with nutritious meals, enough sleep and time in nature. Treat self-care as a necessity. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests neglecting yourself or exhausting yourself caring for others. Rest, ask someone to share household tasks and set aside your own time to recharge.

pentacles-queen.symbolism: The queen sits on a throne carved with fruit and children, in a garden full of roses and green plants, cradling a large coin in her lap like something precious. A small rabbit in the lower corner symbolizes fertility and abundance. The arch of flowers behind and the distant mountains show harmony with nature. Her red cloak and the green background bring out the warmth. She looks down at the coin with affection, as if caring for something important. The card belongs to the element of Water within the suit of Pentacles, combining nurturing intuition with practicality.
pentacles-queen.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: caring.

pentacles-king.name: King of Pentacles
pentacles-king.meaning_upright: The King of Pentacles is a practical leader who has built prosperity through discipline and patience. He sits in a vineyard heavy with fruit, on a throne carved with bulls, holding a scepter and a coin. The card represents stability, dependability and the ability to manage resources wisely. You may be in a stage of reaping results, or need to see everything in a practical, responsible way. Invest with calculation, look after those who depend on you and use your success to create lasting value. The wealth of the King of Pentacles is not only in assets but in the ability to protect and nurture what he has built.
pentacles-king.meaning_reversed: When the King of Pentacles is reversed, success may turn into greed, boasting or material obsession. You may be too stubborn about old methods, tightly controlling money or using wealth to dominate others. You may also fear loss and so hold on too much. The card reminds you to revisit your true values, share resources wisely and stay flexible. Wealth without connection is empty.

love.upright: In love, the King of Pentacles suggests a reliable, protective and steady partner. Show affection through care, long-term commitment and building a shared future. Do not forget to express feelings in words so that security does not become distance.
love.reversed: Reversed, it suggests control through money, a patronizing attitude or rigidity. Open your heart to listen, share decision-making and remember that love cannot be bought with assets.

career.upright: In your career, the card encourages steady leadership, practical decisions and building a lasting organization. Roles in management, business, finance or real estate may suit you. Keep your credibility and treat your team fairly.
career.reversed: Reversed, it shows a rigid management style, too much emphasis on profit or arrogance from success. Listen to employees, innovate and remember that reputation comes from how you treat others.

study.upright: In study, you have built up solid knowledge and can lead others. Keep your discipline, invest for the long term and share your experience.
study.reversed: Reversed, you may be too pragmatic, conservative or focused only on results. Look more broadly and avoid studying only for the credential.

finance.upright: In finances, the card suggests prosperity, security and the ability to invest long term. Keep up discipline, diversify sensibly and use assets to create value for your family and community. Consult a professional for big decisions.
finance.reversed: Reversed, it warns of greed, risk from overconfidence or assets being controlled unreasonably. Re-evaluate your portfolio, avoid showing off and do not bet everything on one item.

mind.upright: For well-being, the card encourages steady habits, disciplined care of the body and enjoying a balanced life. Have regular checkups and keep a healthy lifestyle. For specific health concerns, ask a professional.
mind.reversed: Reversed, it suggests an overemphasis on work or excessive material indulgence affecting your health. Adjust your rhythm of life, rest enough and keep up exercise.

pentacles-king.symbolism: The king sits on a throne carved with bull heads and grape patterns, in a cloak embroidered with bunches of grapes, his right hand holding a scepter and his left hand supporting a coin on his thigh. The vineyard and flowers behind him and the castle on the hill show prosperity and power built over time. The bull's head suggests the strength of the earth and endurance. His steady seated posture and calm face show confidence with a foundation. The card belongs to the element of Air within the suit of Pentacles, combining reason with matter and representing success that has been consolidated.
pentacles-king.miu: Miu does not understand money, but storing dried fish? Miu is great at that. This card reminds you: prosperity.
